name: Kino
summary: An AI video editor for teams and agents: store, search and edit footage on a shared timeline, let Claude or Codex edit via MCP, and collect review notes in one place.
description: An AI video editor for teams and agents: store, search and edit footage on a shared timeline, let Claude or Codex edit via MCP, and collect review notes in one place.

pricing.details: Free forever (100 MCP calls/week). Editor 22 €/editor/month or 18 €/editor/month billed yearly; Editor Plus 178 €/editor/month (includes 89 € agent credit and 67 € Seedance credit). Enterprise custom.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Built-in AI chat and a real-time collaborative timeline
MCP server for your own agents (Claude, Codex)
Free plan with weekly MCP calls
